committee.sub: Morning brief · Friday 6 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The A$600 test credit is now fully drawn (creditRemainingExGst A$0) after 88 raw paid clicks and A$612.88 ex-GST spent, so the pause rule is live: paid search should pause unless cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked, and review_cta_click still sits at 0.

Impression share is 10% over 30 days with 74.2% lost to rank versus only 18.4% lost to budget, so rank/quality looks like the bigger constraint right now, not budget (which stays fixed while the test runs).

Of the 88 raw clicks since the test began, ask_cta_click sits at 18 and quick_question_click at 3 but review_cta_click is still 0; the page passed the 25-click mark long ago so headline, offer and CTAs stay frozen unless something breaks.

One new generate_lead fired this week (Tue 3 Nov), the first since the genuine 23 Sept enquiry; with totalPaidClicks at 88 the test has crossed the 75-click red-flag threshold, so Chris needs to check the test log for qualified counts against this raw figure.

actions.text: Credit remaining is A$0, the decision point is due now: pause paid search unless cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or under and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review.
totalPaidClicks has reached 88, past the 75-click flag; check the test log now and if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries, treat the campaign as red-flagged.
One generate_lead fired this week; check the Formspree/Cal.com email for its recorded source and grade it against the qualified rule in the test log, it is not yet counted as demand.
The page is well past click 25, so the headline, offer and calls to action stay frozen unless something is actually broken.
Open item: logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still outstanding.
Open item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to current site stats.

weekly: the A$600 promo credit is now exhausted (A$612.88 ex-GST spent, A$0 remaining) after 88 raw paid clicks, with zero review bookings recorded and a test-log check now due.
last 7 days had 37 sessions against 55 the week before, a 33% drop, with Thu 5 at 7 sessions versus 13 on the same weekday the prior week (Thu 29).
a single generate_lead fired on Tue 3 Nov and must be checked against its Formspree/Cal.com source data and graded, it is not evidence of demand on its own.
Paid and direct traffic both eased
Paid Search fell to 16 sessions from 24 and Direct to 14 from 22, while AI Assistant traffic stayed at zero for a second straight week.

Organic Search sessions slipped to 6 from 8, and Search Console data (through 3 Nov, so a couple of days behind) shows just 3 clicks from 221 impressions over 8 days, with the top page /simpro-xero-integration.html getting 1 click from 118 impressions.
